info.name: Portfolio Venus API (Production)
info.description:
API operations for the live site at https://joe-burton.com.

**Setup**
- `baseUrl` is `https://joe-burton.com` (no trailing slash).
- Admin/destructive routes (`add-one`, `bulk-add`, `delete-all`, update work by id, delete work by id) require the header `x-admin-secret` to equal the server's `ADMIN_API_SECRET`. Set the `adminSecret` collection variable (store it as a Postman *secret* variable, not in version control). Without it these return 401.
- `workId` targets a MongoDB `companiesAndProjects` doc by string `_id` (e.g. `publicis-sapient`).
- `projectId` targets a static seed project `_id`.

**⚠️ This hits real data.** `Delete all work`, `Bulk add / seed work` (replaces matching docs), `Update work by id` and `Delete work by id` are destructive against the production database. The requests marked destructive are disabled by default — enable them deliberately.

request.description: All `companiesAndProjects` docs, sorted by `sortOrder` ascending. Read-only.
Single doc by string `_id`. 404 if not found. Read-only.

⚠️ Partially updates one production doc by string `_id`. Only the fields present in the body are changed (`$set`); any `_id` in the body is ignored — the URL param is authoritative. Returns the updated document. 400 if the body has no fields to update, 404 if no match.

Insert one doc into production. Send an optional string `_id`; otherwise it is slugified from `company` (numeric suffix if the slug is taken). `sortOrder` is assigned as max+1. Returns 201 `{ _id, sortOrder }`. 409 if a supplied `_id` already exists.

body.raw:
[ { "_id": "example-co", "company": "Example Co", "role": "Front-end Lead", "logo": "example.png", "logoSize": "small", "description": "

What I did here.

", "skills": "React, TypeScript", "className": "example-co", "links": [] } ]

request.description: ⚠️ Idempotent upsert keyed on `_id` — each matching production doc is REPLACED wholesale, and `sortOrder` for every item in the payload is rewritten from array position. Docs not in the payload are left untouched (this does not wipe the collection). Every item must have a string `_id`. Returns `{ upsertedCount, modifiedCount }`.
⚠️ Permanently deletes one production doc by string `_id`. 404 if no match.
⚠️ Wipes the entire production `companiesAndProjects` collection. Returns `{ deletedCount }`. There is no undo.
Static array baked into the build. Read-only.
Single static project by `_id`. 404 if not found. Read-only.
Sends a real email to the site owner's inbox via nodemailer/Gmail. Returns `{ success: true }`. Use sparingly on production.
